title: Zephaniah Bible Quiz - Chapter 3
description: Ten questions on Zephaniah 3: the rebellious city and her leaders, the gathering of the nations, and the song over Zion.

questions.text: What does the opening woe call the rebellious and polluted one?
questions.explanation: Zephaniah 3:1 pronounces woe on her who is rebellious and polluted, the oppressing city.

questions.text: What did she refuse to receive, according to the second verse?
questions.explanation: She did not obey the voice and did not receive correction; she did not trust in Yahweh or draw near to her God.

questions.text: What are her judges compared to?
questions.explanation: Her princes within her are roaring lions and her judges are evening wolves that leave nothing until the next day.

questions.text: What does the text say her priests have done?
questions.explanation: Her priests have profaned the sanctuary, and they have done violence to the law.

questions.text: What does Yahweh do every morning within her?
questions.explanation: Yahweh within her is righteous and does no wrong; every morning he brings his justice to light.

answers.text: He sends word by the prophets
He hides his face from her
He brings his justice to light
He accepts the offering of the city

questions.text: What does Yahweh say his determination is?
questions.explanation: Yahweh tells them to wait for him, for his determination is to gather the nations and assemble the kingdoms, to pour out his indignation on them.

answers.text: To gather the nations and assemble the kingdoms
To build a wall around Jerusalem
To send rain on the mountains

questions.text: What will Yahweh purify so that all may call on his name?
questions.explanation: He says he will purify the lips of the peoples, that they may all call on Yahweh's name and serve him shoulder to shoulder.

questions.text: What kind of people will Yahweh leave among them?
questions.explanation: He will leave among them an afflicted and poor people, and they will take refuge in Yahweh's name.

questions.text: Who is said to be among them, so that they will not be afraid of evil any more?
questions.explanation: Yahweh has taken away their judgments and thrown out their enemy; the King of Israel, Yahweh, is among them.

questions.text: How will Yahweh, who is among them, rejoice over them?
questions.explanation: Yahweh their God is among them, a mighty one who will save; he will rejoice over them with joy and with singing, and calm them in his love.
